events_seen: CUT (Oct 21 (yesterday)): Kevin released Darius Slayton (WR, FA).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 21 (yesterday)): Charles added Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI) (dropped Chris Brooks (RB, GB)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 21 (yesterday)): Adam added Savion Williams (WR, GB) (dropped Austin Ekeler (RB, WAS)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 20 (2 days ago)): Drew added Pierre Strong Jr. (RB, GB) for $25 FAAB (dropped CJ Daniels (WR, LAR)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 18 (4 days ago)): Charles added Jarrett Stidham (QB, DEN) (dropped Isaiah Williams (WR, NYJ)).
CUT (Oct 17 (5 days ago)): Corbishley released Jacob Saylors (RB, DET).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 17 (5 days ago)): Corbishley added Tanner McKee (QB, PHI) (dropped Carson Wentz (QB, MIN)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 16 (6 days ago)): Kevin added Jahan Dotson (WR, ATL).

WEEK 6 RESULTS: Fronge def. Corbishley, 103.8-88.3; Charles def. Adam, 136.8-112.3; Brent def. Drew, 132.3-57.5 (BLOWOUT); Jake def. Shaq, 113.8-101.9; Kevin def. Wingard, 114.3-59.7 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Ryan, 149.1-122.1

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Twelve and zero. Undefeated. Facing Wingard, who just surrendered 114 points to Kevin and is 3-9 on the year. Whatever Charles does to that franchise on Thursday night, the Ledger will need a new column for it.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: MITCHUM PUT UP 149.1 POINTS LAST WEEK. ONE HUNDRED AND FORTY-NINE. BEAT THE DEFENDING CHAMPION BY 27. NOW GETS BRENT IN WEEK 7 AND PEOPLE WANT TO TALK ABOUT CHARLES AGAIN. DEEPWATER IS 8-4 WITH 861.6 POINTS FOR AND I NEED SOMEONE TO EXPLAIN WHY THIS FIRM IS NOT THE CONVERSATION.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Kevin cut Darius Slayton yesterday and added Jahan Dotson six days ago, and Redline is sitting at 9-3 after blowing out Wingard by 54 points. That is a front office that is actively managing a playoff push, not rearranging condemned furniture. The $93.69 exchange price is underselling what that record says.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Fronge last week, the score was 103.8-88.3, and now the question the whole desk is dodging is whether ForgeHammer covers in Havana again when Ryan comes to town. Defending champ, 7-5, still floating on that championship premium — I am not fading FORG a second consecutive week, and my 7-5 season record says I have earned the right to say that out loud.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Drew added Pierre Strong for $25 FAAB, Adam added Savion Williams and dropped Ekeler, and both teams play each other this week at 0-12 and 2-10 respectively. I'm picking Adam because he has a pulse. That is the full analysis. Sometimes the bar is just being the team that has scored more than 547 points all season.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Since Vance is going to keep tagging me until I answer: yes, Mitchum is in the top four of the updated rankings. 8-4 and 861.6 PF earns the placement. The loss to Ryan is in the model. The model did not care. Stop treating the rankings like a feelings exercise.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Eight and four on the season, locks two and zero, and the Jake vs Kevin preview is still not getting air time on this network. I will settle for a written column at this point. That matchup is a playoff-seeding event — EchoPoint at 6-6 hosting Redline at 9-3, both sides with legitimate stakes, and we are spending the segment budget on the Atlas-Helix void match.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The exchange has Obsidian at $78.45, up 3.4% last issue, and Brent draws Mitchum this week after a 132.3-57.5 demolition of Drew. OBS owns the TE desk in this league and cannot buy a win projection — now gets a team that just put up 149. The Ledger is going to have thoughts.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Corbishley dropped Carson Wentz and picked up Tanner McKee five days ago, then lost to a 5-7 team out of Havana. Now faces Shaq, who the exchange just repriced up 5.1% to $97.65. APEX is at $123.78 and bleeding — that number is going to look very fragile by Sunday night if McKee is the answer at QB.
